description: Karonga historical flood occurrences and impacts dataset (2000-2018) is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. Secondary data on historical flood events, their location, date and recorded impacts in Karonga district of Northern Malawi. As Karonga district is mainly affected by flash flooding, the dataset is specifically driven toward flash flood type risk analysis. Coverage: Malawi. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. Its tags are Flash Floods, Malawi, Karonga, impact database. The repository dates the deposit 2021; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge but the files are restricted (Zenodo access right: restricted). The licence is Restricted Access. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
